sections.title: Income tax: individuals
sections.basis: taxable income of an individual for the year (the calendar year)
sections.note: Schedule 6, paragraph 1(a)-(c), with the $10,000 tax-free threshold as amended by LN 2/2021 (commencement 1 July 2021). Laws of Tuvalu 2022 Revised Edition on Tuvalu Legislation On-line, which lists no later amendment.

rows.label: PAYE: employers withhold income tax from wages
rows.value: Employers withhold income tax from emoluments: the pay for the period less approved-fund (provident fund) contributions is grossed up to a year, taxed at the Schedule 6 rates (the $10,000 tax-free threshold only for the employee's principal employment) and divided by the number of pay periods

sections.title: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents

rows.label: Non-resident withholding tax: dividends and service fees
rows.note: non-resident withholding income: dividends, service fees and specified alimony payments (treaty rates may be lower). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Non-resident withholding tax: other gross income (such as interest and royalties)
rows.note: non-resident withholding income other than dividends, service fees or specified alimony (for example interest and royalties). The Act's table prints the rates in a column (15%, 15%, 15%, 30%) against items (a) to (d); read as 30% for item (d). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Withholding on throughput: petroleum supplies, carriage by non-residents and general insurance premiums
rows.note: payments to non-residents (or entities they control) for petroleum supplies and for carriage of passengers and goods from Tuvalu, and general risk insurance premiums for Tuvalu risks (withheld by the payer). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Provident fund: employee contribution
rows.note: member's gross earnings (Group 1 contributions, deducted from salary by the employer). Tuvalu National Provident Fund (Provident Fund Act). Laws of Tuvalu 2022 Revised Edition on Tuvalu Legislation On-line, which lists no later amendment. The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Provident fund: employer contribution
rows.note: gross earnings of each member employed under a contract of service (Group 2 contributions). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Provident fund: employed seafarers (employee contribution; employer or agent 5%)
rows.note: gross earnings of employed seafarers (Schedule 2; the employer or agent pays 5%). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Income tax: resident companies
rows.note: taxable income of a resident company (also trusts and estates, local authorities, charities and the National Bank of Tuvalu). Laws of Tuvalu 2022 Revised Edition on Tuvalu Legislation On-line, which lists no later amendment. The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Income tax: companies under Schedule 6 item (j) (40%)
rows.note: taxable income of the companies in Schedule 6, item (j). Under review: item (j) of Schedule 6 reads 'Taxable income of any resident company 40%', directly after item (i) on resident companies at 30%; it presumably means non-resident companies (branches), but the published text does not say so. Owner check against the gazetted Act. The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Income tax: resident approved (pension) funds
rows.note: taxable income of an approved fund resident in Tuvalu. The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Consumption tax registration threshold
rows.note: taxable supplies expected in, or made in, any 12-month period (supplies of associates counted); voluntary registration below it. The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Consumption tax standard rate
rows.note: taxable supplies by taxable persons (from 1 July 2012) and taxable imports (from 1 July 2009). The Act lets the Minister set the rate by regulation between 3% and 10%. Laws of Tuvalu 2022 Revised Edition on Tuvalu Legislation On-line, which lists no later amendment.

rows.label: Consumption tax exemptions
rows.value: Exempt: medical, dental, nursing and health services; education; financial services; residential land leases; distillate fuel and generator spare parts imported by the Tuvalu Electricity Corporation; imports by government entities and diplomats
rows.note: The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Consumption tax zero rate
rows.value: 0%: exports of goods and of services used outside Tuvalu, international transport, and transfers of a business as a going concern between registered persons
rows.note: The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

rows.label: Room tax
rows.note: accommodation charges at licensed boarding houses and hotels (collected by the operator).

rows.label: Airport departure tax
rows.note: each passenger embarking at a Tuvalu airport for a destination outside Tuvalu (transit passengers, children under 12 and crews on duty exempt). The Airport Departure Tax and Aviation Safety and Security (Amendment) Act 2026 (in force 1 November 2026) allows further special levies by order in a new Schedule 4; none was read. Unit: per passenger.

source.title: Airport Departure Tax and Aviation Safety and Security Act (CAP. 26.01), 2022 Revised Edition

rows.label: Aviation safety and security levy
rows.note: each passenger embarking at a Tuvalu airport for a destination outside Tuvalu. Unit: per passenger.

source.title: Airport Departure Tax and Aviation Safety and Security Act (CAP. 26.01), 2022 Revised Edition
Airport Departure Tax and Aviation Safety and Security Act (CAP. 26.01), 2022 Revised Edition

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Presumptive tax: businesses with gross income under $100,000 not registered for consumption tax
rows.note: annual gross income in the previous year of a business that is not registered for consumption tax and existed throughout that year (below it: presumptive tax, a final tax).

rows.label: Presumptive tax: gross income of $10,000 or less
rows.note: actual gross income of $10,000 or less ($25 a quarter).

rows.label: Presumptive tax: gross income of $10,001 to $30,000
rows.note: actual gross income of $10,001 to $30,000 ($62.50 a quarter).

rows.label: Presumptive tax: gross income of $30,001 to $50,000
rows.note: actual gross income of $30,001 to $50,000 ($125 a quarter).

rows.label: Presumptive tax: gross income of $50,001 to $100,000 (share of quarterly gross income)
rows.note: gross income of each quarter, for annual gross income of $50,001 to $100,000 (paid quarterly; quarterly return within 15 days of the quarter end).

rows.label: Withholding on payments to non-residents for work performed in Tuvalu
rows.note: amounts paid or credited to a non-resident for work performed in Tuvalu by the non-resident or its employee or representative (not otherwise covered by Schedule 5). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

sections.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.

sections.title: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances

rows.label: Traveller allowance: consumption tax exemption for accompanied imports
rows.note: imports accompanying a person arriving in Tuvalu (exempt from consumption tax up to this value). The Act gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (1 January 2026).

sources.title: Airport Departure Tax and Aviation Safety and Security Act (CAP. 26.01), 2022 Revised Edition
